Messages.Author: dan
Messages.Body:
Hello,
I have question about Raphael Catarari with Vessel. I have tapped
Raphael Catarari with 5 bloods and with Vessel. Can I move blood from
him to my pool during untap phase and then untap him?

And another question is about Raphael Catarari and Voter Captivation.
I have Raphael Catarari with 3 bloods who pass politic action with 4
votes. He uses Voter captivation. Can I move two blood to my pool and
one blood to Raphael Catarari? Or I must move two bloods to him?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Apr 3, 1:14 pm, dan <xfoj...@centrum.cz> wrote:
> Hello,
> I have question about Raphael Catarari with Vessel. I have tapped
> Raphael Catarari with 5 bloods and with Vessel. Can I move blood from
> him to my pool during untap phase and then untap him?

No. He already did not untap as normal. The first thing you do in your
untap phase is untap your cards. [4]

> And another question is about Raphael Catarari and Voter Captivation.
> I have Raphael Catarari with 3 bloods who pass politic action with 4
> votes. He uses Voter captivation. Can I move two blood to my pool and
> one blood to Raphael Catarari? Or I must move two bloods to him?

Two.
